question: In April 2025, the World Bank and International Monetary Fund (IMF) held their Spring Meetings in which U.S. city?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Washington, D.C.**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The **Spring Meetings** of the **International Monetary Fund (IMF)** and the **World Bank Group (WBG)** are held annually in **April** in **Washington, D.C.**, where both institutions are headquartered.
 
• For the year **2025**, the **Spring Meetings** are scheduled to take place from **April 21 to April 27, 2025**.
 
• These meetings serve as a primary platform for **Finance Ministers**, **Central Bank Governors**, **private sector executives**, and **academics** to discuss issues of global concern, including **poverty eradication** and **economic development**.
 
• The core of the event involves meetings of the **International Monetary and Financial Committee (IMFC)** and the **Development Committee**, which provide strategic direction to the two institutions.
